title: ngx-sitemaps configuration
description: Configuration file for ngx-sitemaps sitemap generation

excludedPaths.description: Paths to exclude from the sitemap. Supports wildcard patterns using **.

routes.description: Per-route customization for lastmod, priority, and changefreq. Keys are route paths or wildcard patterns.

lastmod.description: Last modification date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use null to fall back to today's date.

priority.description: Priority of this URL relative to other URLs (0.0 to 1.0). Use null to omit.

changefreq.description: How frequently the page is likely to change. Use null to omit.
